title: Russian — MVD Order No. 310, French-style variant (Soviet-era passports)
authority: MVD Russia Order No. 310 of 26.05.1997, French variant (Soviet passport practice)
description: French-based, diacritic-free spelling used in Soviet international passports and kept as the 'French' variant of the MVD 310 instruction: Ж→J, У→OU, Ч→TCH, Ш→CH, Щ→CHTCH, Ю→IOU, ГЕ/ГИ/ГЫ→GUE/GUI/GUY, КС→X, С between vowels→SS, final ИН→INE.
notes: Rules as listed by iuliia.ru/mvd-310 (Гирев → Guirev, Васильева → Vassilieva, Оксана → Oxana, Максимов → Maximov, Гусев → Goussev, Васин → Vassine). iuliia's JSON ignores the С→SS rule; this scheme implements it.
Only ИН is documented for the final -NE; -ЫН (Солженицын → Soljenitsyne in French usage) is not applied.
ЬЁ is not covered by the documented ЬЕ → IE rule: Ь is dropped and Ё → E.

rules.note: С between two vowels → SS (Гусев → Goussev)
